File contract: Write final class Solution in Solution.java with the static method shown; java.util types may be imported.
Required API: public static List<Integer> tokenBucketTrace(int capacity, int initial, int refill, List<Integer> costs)
Behavior: Start with initial tokens. Before every request except the first, refill and cap at capacity. If cost is affordable, spend it and emit remaining tokens; otherwise keep state and emit -(available+1). Reject invalid negative settings/costs or initial above capacity; empty costs succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 5, initial 3, refill 2, costs [2,5,1,4] return [1,-4,4,1]; -4 records rejection with 3 available tokens.

Buggy source to repair:

import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> tokenBucketTrace(int capacity,int initial,int refill,List<Integer>costs){int tokens=initial;var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int c:costs){tokens=Math.min(capacity,tokens+refill);tokens-=c;out.add(tokens);}return out;}}

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> tokenBucketTrace(int capacity,int initial,int refill,List<Integer>costs){if(capacity<0||initial<0||initial>capacity||refill<0)return null;int tokens=initial;var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int i=0;i<costs.size();i++){int c=costs.get(i);if(c<0)return null;if(i>0)tokens=Math.min(capacity,tokens+refill);if(c<=tokens){tokens-=c;out.add(tokens);}else out.add(-tokens-1);}return out;}}
